units: Haar HH and MAD G1-G4 sigmas in linear Rec.2020 Y/Co/Cg plane units, 32x32 grid tiles

rules.e: q25 of all tiles of the bin / bias (0.933, 0.874, 0.861), >= 8 tiles, else nearest bin
rules.s: median of frame-A tiles within the frozen combined envelope, >= 16 tiles, else abstain; one factor per plane and scale from training pairs
rules.truth: median of D over quiet tiles of the mean-image bin, >= 8 tiles
rules.e_mid: E HH times its band ratio (0.614, 2.095, 2.74)

limitations: R6 Mark III pairs only, four held-out pairs; D is a differential residual after development, not the marginal noise of one frame; tiles are correlated; E's bias constants come from earlier pair summaries that may include these pairs
